annotations.title: Get all offers for a game

description: Return every tracked offer for one game: each store's listed price, region, region lock, stock and seller, plus `best`, the cheapest in-stock offer in the market's currency. Use it when the reader wants to compare stores, editions or regions for a game, after search_games, find_games or list_deals has given its `slug`; their summaries already carry the lowest price per platform. `slug` is lower-case with hyphens (elden-ring), and an unknown slug returns an error result; `country` sets the currency `best` is chosen in and which keys are flagged regionLocked, as they may not activate in that market. Offers follow the page's order, official stores first and then marketplaces, each cheapest first, so the first offer is not always the cheapest; each says when its price was last checked. Links go through getcheapgames.com and carry the stores' partner tracking; listed prices exclude the service fee marketplaces add at checkout.

country.description: Two-letter market code, any case, e.g. de, gb, us, br or pl (40 markets). It decides the currency prices come back in, which keys count as region-locked, and the market every link opens in. Omitted or unsupported codes fall back to ie (Ireland, euro).

slug.description: The game's slug, lower-case with hyphens, e.g. "elden-ring": the `slug` field of a search, deals or finder result.

name: get_game_offers

best.description: The cheapest in-stock offer; null when none is.

checkoutFee.description: Whether a fee is added at checkout.

pricesByPlatform.description: Lowest price per platform, e.g. {"PC": "19.99 EUR"}.
